exposure.needed: whether the environment's tooling or clients consume the Kafka node certificate Secrets and depend on the previous single-Secret layout

consequence.statement: Kafka node certificates are now stored in separate Secrets, one Secret per pod, instead of in a single shared Secret, so consumers of the previous Secret layout will see a different structure.

assertion.statement: In Strimzi 0.46.0, Kafka node certificates are stored in separate Secrets, one Secret per pod, instead of a single shared Secret.

proposal.undeterminedReason: subject: The changelog line describes an internal change to the operator's Secret layout for Kafka node certificates; no Secret names or keys are stated and no available subject family (crd-field, helm-value, gvk, config-key, migration, ...) captures a generated-Secret storage layout.
